title: A Few Teacher Steps Go a Long Way: Cost-Efficient On-Policy Data Augmentation for Agent Post-Training
abstract: arXiv:2607.04574v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: For LLM agents, supervised fine-tuning is not only about teacher labels' quality, but also about which interaction contexts those labels condition on. Pure behavioral cloning uses full teacher demonstrations, creating a mismatch between teacher-induced contexts seen in training and student-induced contexts encountered at test time. Recent work addresses this mismatch by querying a teacher at contexts reached by the student, often with increasingly elaborate filtering of the teacher's continuations. We instead frame on-policy data construction as a budget-allocation problem: under matched supervision resources, should teacher output be spent on more start-to-finish demos, longer continuations, outcome filtering, or broader coverage of learner-induced contexts? We formalize this design space through the rollout policy, switch-time distribution, continuation horizon, filtering rules, and two complementary costs: teacher inference

translated_title: 少量教师步骤大有裨益：面向智能体后训练的高性价比同策略数据增强
translated_abstract: 对于大语言模型智能体而言，监督微调不仅关乎教师标签的质量，还关乎这些标签所条件化的交互上下文。纯粹的行为克隆使用完整的教师演示，导致训练中所见的教师诱导上下文与测试时所遇到的学生诱导上下文之间存在不匹配。近期工作通过在学生到达的上下文处查询教师来解决这一不匹配问题，并往往对教师的续写内容进行日益精细的过滤。我们则将同策略数据构建视为一个预算分配问题：在监督资源匹配的情况下，教师输出应该用于更多的从头到尾的完整演示、更长的续写、基于结果的过滤，还是更广泛地覆盖学习者诱导的上下文？我们通过展开策略、切换时间分布、续写视界、过滤规则，以及两种互补的成本——教师推理（成本）……来将这一设计空间形式化。
tldr: 该论文将智能体后训练中的同策略数据构建形式化为一个预算分配问题，系统权衡教师演示、续写长度、过滤规则与上下文覆盖等设计维度，发现少量教师步骤即可带来显著收益，从而实现高性价比的数据增强。
en_tdlr: This paper formalizes on-policy data construction for agent post-training as a budget-allocation problem, systematically weighing teacher demonstrations, continuation length, filtering rules, and context coverage, and shows that a few teacher steps go a long way toward cost-efficient data augmentation.
